chunks: What Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abi al-Jarud, who said:
I asked Aba Ja'far عليه السلام about a place that had been a latrine, then is cleaned and made into a masjid. He said: Soil should be spread over it until it covers it, then it is purer.

key_terms.أَطْهَرُ: purer or more suitable in terms of taharah
key_terms.التُّرَابِ: soil or earth spread over the place
key_terms.الْمَكَانِ: the place or site being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.حَشًّا: a latrine or place used for relieving oneself
key_terms.مَسْجِدًا: a masjid, a place designated for worship and sajdah
key_terms.يُنَظَّفُ: is cleaned or purified from its prior state
key_terms.يُوَارِيَهُ: covers or conceals it from view

ai.seo_question: How can a place that was formerly a latrine be purified and made into a masjid according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a place that had formerly been used as a latrine and is later cleaned for use as a masjid. It indicates that covering it with soil until the former filth is concealed serves as a means of rendering it purer for such use.
